onboarding.title: Welcome to SlimeTora!
onboarding.welcome: SlimeTora is a middleware program that allows you to connect your HaritoraX trackers to the SlimeVR server, bypassing the official software!
onboarding.setup: Please select how you would like to setup SlimeTora. After you have set up the program, you will be guided on how to set up SlimeVR server.

home.none: No trackers found! Maybe connect some :)

tooltip.mag_status: Magnetometer status. If all trackers are consistently "GREAT", it is preferred to use sensor mode 1.
tooltip.rssi: Wireless signal strength (RSSI). Higher (closer to 0) is better.

pairing.title: Pairing management
pairing.subtitle: Pair and manage your HaritoraX trackers via Bluetooth (LE) or Serial/GX(6/2) connections
pairing.enable_connect: Enable trackers to connect or pair devices

error.device_not_found: Could not find {{name}} ({{serial}}). Is it powered on and nearby?
error.invalid_advertisement: The Bluetooth advertisement does not contain a tracker serial number.

bluetooth.title: Bluetooth (LE) Pairing
bluetooth.no_paired_devices: No saved devices. Scan for devices to add them.

serial.title: Serial / GX(6/2) Pairing
serial.no_ports: No serial ports configured. Please configure the serial ports in the connection settings first.

per_tracker.title: {{name}} Settings
per_tracker.description: Override the hardware settings for this tracker. Can be useful if only certain trackers have bad magnetometer statuses.

error.settings_partial: Some tracker settings could not be applied: {{settings}}
error.settings_unavailable: Settings are not available from the connected device.

fps.name: FPS transfer rate
fps.tooltip: Select how many times the trackers send data per second. 50 FPS may be more stable on Bluetooth and use less battery, but isn't as smooth as 100 FPS.

sensor_mode.name: Sensor mode
sensor_mode.tooltip: Mode 1 enables the magnetometer which reduces drift if you have a stable geomagnetic environment. Mode 2 disables the magnetometer and is recommended for unstable environments.

sensor_auto_correction.name: Sensor auto correction
sensor_auto_correction.tooltip: Enable or disable sensor auto correction (dynamic calibration) features. Usually not needed to be changed and results vary between environments.

virtual_feet.name: Virtual feet trackers
virtual_feet.tooltip: Enables the use of the ankle/leg sensor to track the motion of your feet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.restart: Some settings require a restart of the tracker connection to take effect.

file.load_failed: Could not load settings, the old file has been backed up: {{error}}

behavior.name: App Behavior
behavior.tooltip: Controls general behavior of the app.

start_connection.name: Start connection on open
start_connection.tooltip: Automatically start the connection when the app opens.

turn_off_trackers.name: Turn off trackers on exit
turn_off_trackers.tooltip: Automatically turn off trackers when exiting the app.

visualization_fps.name: Tracker Visualization FPS
visualization_fps.tooltip: Sets the framerate for the 3D tracker visualization. Lower values save resources.

appearance.name: Appearance
appearance.tooltip: Controls the appearance of the app.

update_settings.name: Update Settings
update_settings.tooltip: Manage how the app and language updates are handled.

channel.name: Update Channel
channel.tooltip: Select the update channel for the app. Beta gives you the very latest features, but may be more buggy.

update_settings.app_available_toast: SlimeTora v{{version}} is available, check settings to update
update_settings.app_failed: Could not check for SlimeTora updates
update_settings.language_failed: Could not check or install all language updates

tracker_model.name: Tracker Model
tracker_model.tooltip: Select the model(s) of HaritoraX trackers you have. Multiple can be used at the same time for advanced users.

connection_mode.name: Connection Mode
connection_mode.tooltip: Select the connection mode used to connect to the trackers. Multiple modes can be used simultaneously.

serial_ports.name: Serial Ports
serial_ports.tooltip: Select the serial port(s) your GX(6/2) dongles or HaritoraX 1.1b/1.1/1.0 trackers are using.

slimevr_server.name: SlimeVR Server
slimevr_server.tooltip: Configure where SlimeTora looks for the SlimeVR server. By default, it will look for the server across all of your networks using the local broadcast address (255.255.255.255).

fps.name: FPS transfer rate
fps.tooltip: Select how many times the trackers send data per second. 50 FPS may be more stable on Bluetooth and use less battery, but isn't as smooth as 100 FPS.

sensor_mode.name: Sensor mode
sensor_mode.tooltip: Mode 1 enables the magnetometer which reduces drift if you have a stable geomagnetic environment. Mode 2 disables magnetometer and is recommended for unstable environments.

sensor_auto_correction.name: Sensor auto correction
sensor_auto_correction.tooltip: Enable or disable sensor auto correction (dynamic calibration) features. Usually not needed to be changed and results vary between environments.

virtual_feet.name: Virtual feet trackers
virtual_feet.tooltip: Enables the use of the ankle/leg sensor to track the motion of your feet.

other_settings.name: Other settings
other_settings.tooltip: Additional tracker settings that affect overall performance.

heartbeat.name: Heartbeat Interval (ms)
heartbeat.tooltip: Sets the interval at which the program sends heartbeat signals to the tracker to keep them connected. Usually not necessary to change.

button_debounce.name: Button Debounce (ms)
button_debounce.tooltip: Sets the debounce time for button presses to avoid accidental multiple activations.

show_all_ports.name: Show all serial ports
show_all_ports.tooltip: Disable platform-specific filtering and show every detected serial port.

write_logs.name: Write logs
write_logs.tooltip: Enable or disable writing logs to the disk.

logging_mode.name: Logging Mode
logging_mode.tooltip: Minimal includes basic information, warnings, and errors. Debug adds debug messages. All includes trace messages. More detail can affect performance.

open_data.name: Open Data Folder
open_data.tooltip: Opens the folder where SlimeTora stores its data, such as configuration files and logs, in your file browser.

open_logs.name: Open Logs Folder
open_logs.tooltip: Opens the folder where SlimeTora stores its log files in your file browser.

analytics.title: Anonymous Analytics
analytics.description: Share anonymous app, tracker setup, and OS data purely to fuel Maya's (or your!) curiousity, and maybe help improve the app. No personal information, hardware identifiers, or any other sensitive data is collected.
analytics.payload_id: entityId: a random installation ID, not tied to you or visible to anyone
analytics.payload_frequency: When you start a connection, a report is sent one minute after the first tracker connects - stopping before the minute will not send a report. Some information above may only be shown when you have a tracker connected.

about.description: The SlimeTora project is a middleware program that allows you to connect the HaritoraX trackers to the SlimeVR server.
